description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the EncounterService class in the OpenMRS project. It tests various functionalities related to Encounter management, including saving, updating, voiding, unvoiding, retrieving, and deleting encounters, along with their related entities like Obs, Orders, Diagnoses, and EncounterTypes. The tests extend a base context-sensitive test class and utilize dependency injection, focusing on ensuring the correct behavior of encounter-related operations within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: EncounterServiceTest
classes.description: A test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest that contains unit tests for the EncounterService in OpenMRS. It tests creating, updating, retrieving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting encounters and related entities, ensuring correctness and consistency of data operations.

classes.name: EncounterServiceTest
